synthesis: The five-lane x1 packet is ready for x2 because app lanes completed, CLI lanes passed elaboration gates, and final-marker review cleared metadata-only summary use.
The x2 build should prefer runner and receipt improvements that reduce future manual polling, especially cadence-locked status fusion and false-positive review hardening.
The current-source map points x2 toward bounded execution, scope minimization, skill inventory, and agent-native observability.
The x2 work must avoid live user-skill mutation; proposed skill overlays can be drafted as repo receipts unless an exact live-skill packet is active.
